tools.title: Tool & integration inventory
tools.note: One row per tool, API, model endpoint, datastore, or external capability the agent can invoke.

memory.title: Memory inventory
memory.note: List the actual categories of information the agent may persist. Every persistent memory class should appear here.

safety.title: Risk & guardrail inventory
safety.note: Capture concrete failure modes and the controls that prevent, detect, and respond to them.

evaluation.title: Evaluation suite
evaluation.note: Define measurable checks that can become release gates and production evaluations.

delegation.title: Agent delegation map
delegation.note: Document every permitted caller → callee relationship and how authority/context propagate.

observability.title: Telemetry & audit signals
observability.note: Specify what is captured across gateway, runtime, model, memory, policy, and tool execution.

security.title: Threat model
security.note: Track agent-specific security threats, controls, detection, and residual risk.

readiness.title: Production gate checklist
readiness.note: Use this as the final approval sheet before enabling production traffic or privileged capabilities.

canvases.title: Overview
canvases.desc: The cover sheet for the agent: purpose, contract, profile, and cross-canvas completion.

canvases.title: Agent Definition
canvases.desc: Define the agent’s purpose, boundaries, users, outputs, autonomy, ownership, and failure behavior.
decisions: Purpose
What business or technical outcome is this agent responsible for?
Boundaries
What must this agent explicitly not do?
Users
Who invokes it: humans, applications, agents, or all three?
Inputs & outputs
What input formats are accepted and what output contract is produced?
Model strategy
Primary model, fallbacks, model constraints, and model-selection rules.
Skills
What capabilities does the agent intentionally expose?
Autonomy
At what autonomy level may the agent operate, and where does it stop?
Failure behavior
How should it fail, retry, degrade, or escalate when uncertain or unavailable?
Responsibilities
Define responsibilities, constraints, ownership and review evidence.
Explicit non-responsibilities
Define explicit non-responsibilities, constraints, ownership and review evidence.
Inputs
Define inputs, constraints, ownership and review evidence.
Outputs
Define outputs, constraints, ownership and review evidence.
Human involvement
Define human involvement, constraints, ownership and review evidence.
Ownership
Define ownership, constraints, ownership and review evidence.

canvases.title: Identity & Access
canvases.desc: Define who the agent is, whose authority it uses, and exactly what resources it may access.
decisions: Agent identity
What stable runtime/service identity represents this agent?
Invoker identity
How is the calling user, service, or agent identity preserved?
Invocation policy
Who is allowed to invoke this agent and from which trust boundary?
Delegation
Can this agent invoke other agents, and does identity propagate?
Tool authorization
How are tool-level permissions granted and constrained?
Resource authorization
Which tenants, projects, accounts, datasets, or resources are in scope?
Credential handling
Where do credentials/tokens live and how are they rotated?
Audit attribution
How do logs distinguish user intent, agent execution, and downstream action?
Tenant isolation
Define tenant isolation, constraints, ownership and review evidence.
User delegation
Define user delegation, constraints, ownership and review evidence.
Approval requirements
Define approval requirements, constraints, ownership and review evidence.
Agent-to-agent invocation
Define agent-to-agent invocation, constraints, ownership and review evidence.

canvases.title: Tools & Integrations
canvases.desc: Inventory the capabilities the agent can call and make side effects, authorization, and ownership visible.
decisions: Tool allowlist
How does the runtime decide which tools this agent may see or invoke?
Discovery
Are tools static, registry-driven, MCP-discovered, or dynamically selected?
Input validation
How are tool arguments validated before execution?
Side effects
How are read-only, reversible, external, financial, and destructive actions distinguished?
Approval boundary
Which actions require human approval before execution?
Failure & retry
Which calls may retry, and how are duplicate side effects prevented?

canvases.title: Memory & Context
canvases.desc: Design durable, predictable, governed memory and control how retrieved context enters each run.
decisions: Memory Scope
What specific facts, preferences, decisions, or history must survive across sessions?
Memory Types
Classify persistent items as Episodic, Semantic, or Procedural.
Retrieval
What triggers retrieval, how is it ranked, and what is the injection limit?
Write & Consolidation
Who extracts memories, when are they written, and how are duplicates/conflicts merged?
Staleness
Define timestamps, TTL, refresh behavior, invalidation, and source of truth.
Context Budget
Reserve hard limits for core instructions, retrieved memory, tool context, and recent turns.
Governance
Who can read, write, export, and delete memory? Define retention and auditability.

canvases.title: Safety & Guardrails
canvases.desc: Define what the agent should do, not just what IAM technically allows it to do.
decisions: Autonomy level
Set L0–L5 autonomy and the maximum action class the agent may execute.
Prompt injection
How is untrusted content isolated from instructions and tool authority?
Data handling
How are sensitive inputs, outputs, and tool parameters classified and protected?
Policy enforcement
Where is policy evaluated: before model, before tool call, after tool call, or multiple points?
Human approval
Which conditions force review or confirmation?
Verification
How are high-impact actions verified before and/or after execution?
Emergency controls
How can the agent, tool, tenant, or capability be disabled quickly?

canvases.title: Evaluation & Quality
canvases.desc: Turn agent quality into measurable, repeatable release gates instead of subjective spot checks.
decisions: Success definition
What observable outcome means this agent performed correctly?
Golden dataset
What curated examples represent expected behavior and difficult edge cases?
Tool correctness
How do you evaluate tool choice, arguments, sequencing, and final state?
Policy compliance
What tests prove security and policy controls are respected?
Regression strategy
What runs on prompt, model, tool, memory, or policy changes?
Production evaluation
How are live runs sampled and scored without exposing sensitive data?
Release threshold
What minimum scores and zero-tolerance failures gate deployment?
Task success
Define task success, constraints, ownership and review evidence.
Tool argument accuracy
Define tool argument accuracy, constraints, ownership and review evidence.
Hallucination rate
Define hallucination rate, constraints, ownership and review evidence.
Safety tests
Define safety tests, constraints, ownership and review evidence.
Adversarial tests
Define adversarial tests, constraints, ownership and review evidence.
Latency
Define latency, constraints, ownership and review evidence.
Cost
Define cost, constraints, ownership and review evidence.
Human feedback
Define human feedback, constraints, ownership and review evidence.

canvases.title: Agent Delegation
canvases.desc: Control agent-to-agent calls, authority propagation, recursion, shared context, and failure ownership.
decisions: Delegation policy
Which agents may invoke which other agents?
Maximum depth
How many delegation hops are allowed before execution is stopped?
Identity propagation
Does downstream execution use caller, user, or callee identity?
Context propagation
What minimum context is shared, and what must never cross agent boundaries?
Loop prevention
How are repeated delegation cycles detected and stopped?
Final ownership
Which agent owns the final answer, action receipt, and user-facing error?
Recursive delegation allowed?
Define recursive delegation allowed?, constraints, ownership and review evidence.
Audit ownership
Define audit ownership, constraints, ownership and review evidence.
Failure ownership
Define failure ownership, constraints, ownership and review evidence.

canvases.title: Runtime & Deployment
canvases.desc: Define the shared execution contract inherited by agents running on the agent runtime.
decisions: Environments
How are development, test, staging, and production isolated?
Runtime isolation
What process/container/sandbox boundary exists between agents and tenants?
Network
What ingress and egress paths are allowed from the runtime?
Scaling & concurrency
How does the runtime scale and enforce per-agent/tenant concurrency?
Sessions
Where is session state kept and how long does it survive?
Timeouts & retries
What are execution, model, and tool timeouts and retry budgets?
Deployment
How are versions promoted, canaried, rolled back, and pinned?
Availability
What SLO/SLA and disaster-recovery behavior is required?
Runtime/platform
Define runtime/platform, constraints, ownership and review evidence.
Region
Define region, constraints, ownership and review evidence.
Internet egress
Define internet egress, constraints, ownership and review evidence.
Model access
Define model access, constraints, ownership and review evidence.
Secret management
Define secret management, constraints, ownership and review evidence.
Memory backend
Define memory backend, constraints, ownership and review evidence.
Rollback strategy
Define rollback strategy, constraints, ownership and review evidence.

canvases.title: Registry & Lifecycle
canvases.desc: Define the canonical agent record, ownership, versioning, lifecycle states, and discoverability.
decisions: Canonical ID
What immutable identifier represents the agent across environments?
Registry metadata
Which fields are mandatory: owner, version, runtime, model, tools, classification, autonomy?
Lifecycle
What transitions are allowed from Draft → Production → Retired?
Versioning
What constitutes a new agent version and what remains immutable?
Discovery
Who can discover agents and which metadata is exposed to other agents or users?
Retirement
How are traffic, credentials, memories, tools, and audit records handled at retirement?

canvases.title: Observability
canvases.desc: Specify the telemetry required to understand cost, latency, quality, policy, memory, and tool execution.
decisions: Trace model
What is the end-to-end trace structure from gateway → agent → model → tool → response?
Correlation
Propagate agent_run_id, agent_id, agent_version, session_id, trace_id, caller_id, tool_id, model_id. Define tenant boundaries.
Sensitive telemetry
What data must be redacted, hashed, sampled, or never logged?
Metrics
Which SLO, quality, token, cost, tool, policy, and escalation metrics are mandatory?
Alerts
Which conditions page a human versus create an informational signal?
Audit retention
Which events require longer-term immutable retention?
Agent run tracing
Define agent run tracing, constraints, ownership and review evidence.
Model calls
Define model calls, constraints, ownership and review evidence.
Tool calls
Define tool calls, constraints, ownership and review evidence.
Policy decisions
Define policy decisions, constraints, ownership and review evidence.
Memory retrieval
Define memory retrieval, constraints, ownership and review evidence.
Agent delegation
Define agent delegation, constraints, ownership and review evidence.
Human approvals
Define human approvals, constraints, ownership and review evidence.
Errors
Define errors, constraints, ownership and review evidence.
Token consumption
Define token consumption, constraints, ownership and review evidence.
Cost
Define cost, constraints, ownership and review evidence.
Latency
Define latency, constraints, ownership and review evidence.
Outcome/success
Define outcome/success, constraints, ownership and review evidence.

canvases.title: Security / Threat Model
canvases.desc: Make agent-specific attack paths and trust boundaries explicit before production rollout.
decisions: Trust boundaries
Where do untrusted users, content, tools, models, and external systems enter?
Identity threats
How are spoofing, confused deputy, and privilege escalation prevented?
Prompt threats
How are direct and indirect prompt injection contained?
Memory threats
How are poisoning, cross-tenant leakage, and stale sensitive facts prevented?
Tool threats
How are malicious or compromised tools constrained and monitored?
Data exfiltration
How are outbound channels, model providers, and tool parameters restricted?
Supply chain
How are models, prompts, packages, MCP servers, and tool definitions governed?

canvases.title: Production Readiness
canvases.desc: A final, shareable approval sheet summarizing whether this agent is ready for production.
decisions: Architecture review
Have all relevant canvas decisions been reviewed and documented?
Security review
Has the threat model been reviewed and high/critical risks addressed?
Evaluation gate
Do required offline and regression evaluations pass?
Policy gate
Are access, safety, approval, and runtime policies configured?
Observability gate
Can operators trace, alert, investigate, and audit the agent?
Operational gate
Are runbooks, owners, rollback, and kill switches ready?
Data governance
Are retention, privacy, export, and deletion requirements implemented?
Launch approval
Who gives the final production approval and under what conditions?

SLOs
